Gold, silver, platinum and palladium all closed higher this week, even though Thursday briefly erased the gains across the board.

Platinum led the swings, falling 3.46% to $1,816 on Thursday before rebounding 3.69% to $1,883 on Friday — a net gain of just $2.00 for the week. Silver did best overall, up 2.19% to $70.37, while gold and platinum barely moved net despite the volatility. Every price was cross-checked against Kitco, TradingEconomics and CNBC.
